children.title: Delegation and Governance: Re-framing Obedience Failure

detail.title: Delegation and Governance: Re-framing Obedience Failure
detail.summary: AI ethics failures, often framed as problems of 'autonomy', are identified as instances of delegation failure where human accountability is displaced onto systems with bounded autonomy. Intelligence failures occur when these delegated instructions are executed without adequate override or design-level oversight.
detail.reason: The source identifies a fundamental shift in AI ethics: moving from 'autonomy' risks to 'delegation' failures.
